experiment_data.hypothesis: Oracle SICA with gold FOL annotations on exp-026 regenerated traces (post normalization-fix): if constraint quality is the bottleneck, replacing self-extracted constraints with gold FOL + Z3 entailment should significantly outperform SC and SICA(self), replicating exp-021's finding on fixed code.
experiment_data.notes: KEY RESULT. Oracle-SICA (gold FOL + Z3 entailment + consistency-weighted voting) 89.71% vs SC 75.49% vs SICA(self) 74.51%, +14.22pp over SC, McNemar p=2.0e-07 极显著, b=29 c=0 (oracle 从未输给 SC)。Z3 gold agreement 95.10% (194/204), FOL parser 204/204 全成功。Per-type: True 97.2% (+4.1pp), False 93.6% (+6.3pp), Unknown 78.3% (+31.9pp)。与 exp-021 (88.24%, 旧 traces) 对比：oracle 准确率从 88.24% 提升至 89.71%（+1.47pp），delta 从 +8.82pp 增至 +14.22pp。差异来源：(1) exp-026 traces 的 SC baseline 更低 (75.49% vs 79.41%)；(2) Z3 agreement 从 94.6% 提升至 95.1%。结论与 exp-021 一致：MAX-SAT 聚合机制有效——瓶颈在约束提取质量。
